usage: Four material quadrants projected and baked into independently authored weapon diffuse maps.
prompt: Create a professional PBR base-color material source sheet for realistic low-poly 3D rifle props in a strategy game. A single square image, perfectly aligned 2 by 2 grid, each quadrant filled edge-to-edge with a continuous seamless-looking material surface. No labels, no border, no objects, no weapon silhouettes, no text, no logos, no perspective, no directional lighting, no cast shadows. TOP LEFT: dark charcoal phosphate-coated steel, subtle irregular medium-gray patina, fine machining grain, restrained fine rubbed marks, realistic varied surface instead of flat fill, NOT bright white scratches. TOP RIGHT: rich medium-dark walnut gunstock wood, narrow elongated grain running horizontally, subdued pores and oiled finish, no boards or gaps. BOTTOM LEFT: dark neutral charcoal injection-molded polymer with fine dense irregular stipple and very subtle usage variation. BOTTOM RIGHT: dark cool-gray ceramic-coated metal with fine satin grain, subtle slightly lighter scuffing and tonal variation. High detail useful for close-up game texture baking. The four materials must have even albedo illumination and no baked object edges. Clean maintained equipment with gentle handling wear, never crusted dirt, white paint, camouflage, rust, or excessive damage.
